title: Merge release work from several branches
statement: As a developer, I can have several branches and agents add to the same release, so preparing a release fits how we already work in parallel.
overview: Recommendation for the design: one small file per note, per step and per story link, with a sortable rank for order, the way Tasks and slide Items already work. A list inside `release.json` would conflict on nearly every merge.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Two branches that each add a different note, step or story link to one release merge with no Git conflict, and the result is valid.
Two branches that insert different steps at the same position both keep their steps, in an order that does not depend on which merged first.
Two branches that each create a release of the same version cannot silently merge into two releases of one version: Git conflicts or `validate` names the version.
Two branches that change the same step conflict in Git rather than one silently winning.
